_help: Copy this file to osu_api_config.json and fill it in. Get a client at https://osu.ppy.sh/home/account/edit -> OAuth -> New OAuth Application (any name; callback URL http://localhost). Only the public, read-only client-credentials grant is used. Never share the secret.
_help_user: Your osu! username, or your numeric user id (the number in your profile link osu.ppy.sh/users/<id>). Leave it empty to use the account logged in to osu! on this PC.
_help_user_id: Optional: your numeric osu! user id. If set (not 0) it wins over 'user'. Renamed accounts keep their id, so all your old names still count.
_help_exclude_users: Optional: names or ids of OTHER accounts that play on this PC (a sibling, a second account). Their replays never count as yours. Example: ["my_brother", 1234567]
